meta_description: GTH Painting & Decorating in Nottingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Local, reliable, free quotes.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to showroom-fresh rooms. We handle everything from prep to finish, on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: We transform homes and businesses with expert interior and exterior decoration, from wallpapering to feature walls.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Full interior redecorating including walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We prep properly, use quality paint, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior work on render, wood, and masonry. We work around the seasons and protect your property throughout.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert hanging of wallpaper and paste-the-wall products. We source materials with you and create stunning focal points.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting
services.desc: Professional painting and staining of doors, skirting boards, and joinery. We sand, prime, and finish to a high standard.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Specialist coatings including Artex, polished plaster, and decorative effects. Transform ceilings and walls with texture and colour.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, shop, and rental property work completed on schedule and within budget. We minimise disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the care and attention we'd give our own home.
about_para_1: GTH Painting & Decorating has been serving Nottingham and the surrounding area for over 15 years. We started with a simple idea: do the job properly, respect the customer's home, and finish on time. That approach has built us a loyal base of repeat customers and earned us consistent five-star feedback.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on thorough preparation—the difference between a job that lasts and one that doesn't. We source quality materials, protect your furniture and carpets, and clean up thoroughly at the end. Whether you're refreshing a lounge or redecorating a rental property, you'll get the same professional standard.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge redecorated. The lads were brilliant—turned up on time, got stuck in, and the finish is perfect. Walls look like they've been done by professionals, which of course they have. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: New wallpaper and feature wall in the hallway. They moved furniture, protected everything, and there wasn't a speck of mess left behind. Quality work and friendly service. Very happy.
reviews.author: Linda C.

reviews.text: Exterior repaint on the woodwork and render. Quoted fairly, did the job when they said they would, and the finish has held up really well through the weather. Would use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David M.
